jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst I — Alternative Investments Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY — hybrid, at least 2 days/week in office
jobs.salary: $90,000–$105,000 base + discretionary bonus; only $100K–$105K portion meets target
jobs.why: Strong overlap with Audrey's Orion business analysis, Visio current/future-state mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, Salesforce workflow automation, UAT test cases, stakeholder workshops, training and Excel/Tableau reporting. Financial-reporting operations experience adds adjacent context.
jobs.gap: Requires 3+ years in financial services and investment-operations knowledge; Audrey has adjacent media-finance reporting but no verified private-equity/debt operations, fund administrators/custodians, Appian delivery or integration-spec ownership. Salary floor below target.

jobs.title: Product & Business Operations Associate
jobs.why: Audrey's Horizon Blue ABA healthcare operations automation, centralized staffing records, intake and onboarding workflows, and Orion cross-functional process improvements are relevant to a healthcare startup building new product and business operations processes.
jobs.gap: Startup expects independent end-to-end ownership of ambiguous founder-priority initiatives, potentially beyond Audrey's demonstrated scope. Five office days/week and a broad generalist role; no proven founder-level strategy ownership.

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.salary: $70,000–$100,000 base + equity; only ceiling meets $100K target

Audrey's Horizon Blue ABA intake and onboarding automation plus Orion reporting, UAT, documentation and cross-functional coordination provide concrete parallels.
